claims.claim_ar: جملة مستأنفة مسوقة لبيان ما صدر عنهم من الأعمال المنكرة الموجبة للأمر بجهادهم والغلظة عليهم
claims.claim_en: A resumed (استئنافية) sentence introduced here to present what they did; it serves to set out their objectionable acts that justify the injunction to fight them and to be stern with them.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Frames the following description as evidence of misconduct, foregrounding their hypocrisy and legitimizing the commanded response.

claims.claim_ar: الواو هنا واو استئنافية، والجملة مستأنفة مسوقة لبيان مآل أمرهم
claims.claim_en: The conjunction waw here functions as a resumptionary 'waw' (واو استئناف); the resumed sentence presents the outcome (their abode is Hell), thereby emphasizing their doom.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Creates an emphatic transition to the final judgment, intensifying condemnation and leaving a strong impression of punishment.
